{"subject":"Checking in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a little while, and I wanted to say hello and see how things are going at Turso. I'd love to hear what the team is focused on right now and what's been most exciting lately.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call whenever suits you. No agenda, just a chance to catch up and hear where things are heading.

Hope you're well.

Elena"}
